title: SpaceX catches its Starship spacecraft with the launch tower for the first time
caption:
SpaceX caught the upper stage of its Starship rocket with the arms of its launch tower on Saturday, after about 22 hours in orbit. It is the first time the ship has been recovered this way. Reusing both stages could make spaceflight much cheaper, and NASA plans to use a version of Starship as a Moon lander.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
